title: System & data flow
description: Commands commit recovery state and requested effects atomically. Existing services execute effects after commit. UI projections report actual outcomes; customer delivery remains a separate effect.
mermaid:
flowchart LR
  R[Existing incident intake] -->|Confirmed incident| A[MedicalCasesModule]
  N[Slack / Neutron] -->|Classify and confirm| A
  W[Worker app] -->|Owned input + version| A
  O[Ops console] -->|Authorized review / send| A
  A --> T[(Transaction: case + input + event + impacts + notice / consent + effects)]
  T --> H[All-path medical hold + existing eligibility]
  T --> D[Effect dispatcher]
  D --> S[Existing cancellation / outreach / jobs / todos]
  D --> E[Safe customer delivery]
  S --> X[(Actual execution outcomes)]
  E --> X
  T --> P[Scoped worker / Ops / business projections]
  X --> P

title: Injury intake & recovery
description: Seven days finds duplicate candidates; it does not merge distinct injuries. Booking is held at commit. Shift cancellations execute asynchronously. Expected return is a check-in date, never clearance.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Existing incident report] --> B{Confirmed injury?}
  B -->|Uncertain| C[PENDING_CONFIRMATION; no hold]
  B -->|Yes| D{Same actual incident? Lock intake}
  D -->|Yes| E[Attach report to case]
  D -->|No| F[(Create AWAITING_NOTE case + event + effects)]
  E --> G[Derived injury hold / worker home task]
  F --> G
  G -. Async .-> H[Existing cancellation: next 48h; later shifts review; in-progress alert]
  G --> I[Worker note + visit + clearance + restrictions + date]
  I --> J{FULL / no restrictions?}
  J -->|Yes| K[PENDING_REVIEW; approval flow]
  J -->|No| L[(RECOVERING + submission + event + effects)]
  L --> M[Cancel through RTW date; expected-date or day-14 follow-up]
  M --> N{New note?}
  N -->|Yes| I
  N -->|No| O[+3 reminder / +7 Ops call; invalidate stale cycles]

title: Review, approval & customer notice
description: Approval and customer sending are distinct transactions. A second injury or account restriction survives clearance. Business users see only sent, safe notices.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[(FULL note: PENDING_REVIEW + SLA)] --> B[Ops newest-note review + lock / version]
  B --> C{Decision?}
  C -->|Reject / info| D[(Reason + AWAITING_NOTE + new reminder cycle)]
  D -. New FULL note .-> A
  C -->|Approve| E[(APPROVED submission + RESOLVED case + event + effects)]
  E --> F{Other injury or account restriction?}
  F -->|Yes| G[Booking stays paused; no return notice]
  F -->|No| H[Remove medical hold; ordinary eligibility applies; no rebooking]
  H --> I[Ops preview: safe DRAFT notice]
  I --> J[(Explicit send: recheck + QUEUED + effect)]
  J --> K{Provider result?}
  K -->|Accepted| L[(SENT + provider id; business notice)]
  K -->|Failed / uncertain| M[FAILED / AMBIGUOUS; reconcile without reopening hold]

title: Illness, consent & injury conversion
description: Illness never creates the injury booking hold. Cancellation is already committed before the optional step. Customer absence notices and document consent are independent.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Existing SICKNESS cancellation commits] --> B{Add optional details?}
  B -->|No| C[Skip; no empty case]
  B -->|Yes| D[(ILLNESS RECOVERING + input + event + origin shift)]
  D --> E[No medical hold; early booking reminder can continue]
  D --> F[Opted-in cancellations / note-based exemption; actual outcomes]
  D --> G[Ops preview / send safe absence notice]
  D --> H{Share one document?}
  H -->|No| I[Private by default]
  H -->|Worker agrees| J[(Consent for submission and company; checked every download)]
  D -. Confirmed injury .-> K[Convert same case; preserve history; link Incident; revoke consents; start hold]
  J -. Revoke on conversion .-> K

title: Durable execution & competing updates
description: Leases and stable ids coordinate execution. Actual outcome records drive UI status. Uncertain outbound delivery is reconciled instead of retried blindly; locks and versions protect approvals.
mermaid:
flowchart TD
  A[Concurrent commands: locks + version] -->|Wins| B[(Case + event + effects transaction)]
  A -->|Stale| C[Conflict; no partial changes]
  B --> D[Due effect: acquire lease / increment attempt]
  D --> E{Current state and cycle?}
  E -->|No| F[CANCELLED / skipped]
  E -->|Yes| G[Existing service + stable effect id + actual-state read]
  G --> H{Outcome?}
  H -->|Success| I[(COMPLETE + actual impact / notice + audit)]
  H -->|Safe retry| J[(RETRY + bounded backoff)]
  J --> D
  H -->|Fatal / exhausted| K[FAILED + Ops task]
  H -->|Uncertain send| L[AMBIGUOUS; reconcile without blind resend]

title: Medical case states
description: Insurance claim status is independent of this lifecycle. Medical hold = any INJURY in AWAITING_NOTE, RECOVERING or PENDING_REVIEW. Illness starts RECOVERING. An expected date never auto-clears injury.
mermaid:
stateDiagram-v2
  [*] --> AWAITING_NOTE: confirmed injury
  [*] --> RECOVERING: illness details
  AWAITING_NOTE --> RECOVERING: restricted / not-cleared note
  AWAITING_NOTE --> PENDING_REVIEW: FULL note
  RECOVERING --> PENDING_REVIEW: injury FULL note
  PENDING_REVIEW --> AWAITING_NOTE: reject / request info
  PENDING_REVIEW --> RESOLVED: approve newest FULL note
  RECOVERING --> RESOLVED: illness recovery / Ops close
  RECOVERING --> AWAITING_NOTE: illness converts to injury
  AWAITING_NOTE --> VOIDED: Ops false-report decision
  RECOVERING --> VOIDED: Ops false-report decision
  PENDING_REVIEW --> VOIDED: Ops false-report decision
